Title: Azure Cosmos DB portal updates: New metrics blade and improved collection management

Body.Content:
Azure Cosmos DB, a globally replicated and managed NoSQL database service, added a consolidated metrics experience to the Azure portal. Several new metrics are available, including availability, throughput, consistency, and latency. You can use these metrics to track how well Azure Cosmos DB is meeting its SLAs.

Collection management has also been streamlined by surfacing all collection operations and experiences on the left navigation bar. This has eliminated excessive horizontal scrolling.

Read more about the updates in the Azure blog.
